scoring_justification: The band structure's half-metallic character is recomputed from the submitted spin-resolved energies (T1); the magnetic moment is compared to the paper's reported value (2.0 μB) with tolerance, as it cannot be recomputed without the charge density.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference magnetic moment value (2.0 μB) for comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4b and text: '...a net magnetic moment of 2.0 μB.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Paper's reported value used as target; the checker verifies the agent's DFT result reproduces this value.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing total magnetic moment of the 2×2 supercell.

outputs.description: Total magnetic moment extracted from the spin-polarized SCF calculation.
Spin-resolved band structure along a high-symmetry path. The checker performs a structural audit (details not disclosed).

output_contract.notes: No gold values or tolerances are included in the public contract.
